fact: On 10 February 2026 the Ministry began a two-day stakeholder meeting in Accra to discuss, clause by clause, comments received in public consultation on the Draft Misinformation, Disinformation, Hate Speech and Publication of Other Information Bill.
title: MoCDTI Engages Stakeholders on “Draft Misinformation, Disinformation, Hate Speech and Publication of Other Information Bill”
publisher: Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations
